<!doctype html>
<!-- Appearance placeholders are replaced during SSR from per-device cookies, and the native
     pane-toggles placeholder from the native app's user agent; see hooks.server.ts. -->
<html
	lang="en"
	data-type-scale
	data-amp-theme="theme-0"
	data-amp-color-scheme="system"
	data-amp-terminal-theme="app"
	data-amp-terminal-palette="gruvbox"
	data-amp-text-size="default"
	data-amp-ui-sounds="on"
	data-amp-logo-motion="on"
	data-amp-color-filters="off"
	data-amp-native-pane-toggles=""
	style=""
>
	<head>
		<meta charset="utf-8" />
		<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
		<!-- Scales the root font size (and therefore the rem-based AGENTS(typeScale) type
		     scale and --spacing) with the OS/browser accessibility font-size setting on
		     browsers that support it (Chromium on Android). iOS is unaffected: WebKit
		     ignores this meta and tracks Dynamic Type via `font: -apple-system-body`
		     (server/src/app.css). Do not combine with env(preferred-text-scale); the
		     scale would apply twice. -->
		<meta name="text-scale" content="scale" />
		<style>
			:root {
				color-scheme: light dark;
				--amp-shell-light-background-color: #fafaf8;
				--amp-shell-dark-background-color: #0b0d0b;
				--amp-surface-light-background-color: #f9fdf6;
				--amp-surface-dark-background-color: #0c1516;
			}

			html[data-amp-color-scheme='light'] {
				color-scheme: light;
			}

			html[data-amp-color-scheme='dark'] {
				color-scheme: dark;
			}

			html[data-amp-theme='theme-1'] {
				--amp-shell-light-background-color: #fafafa;
				--amp-shell-dark-background-color: #0c0c0c;
				--amp-surface-light-background-color: #fcfcfc;
				--amp-surface-dark-background-color: #121212;
			}

			html[data-amp-theme='theme-4'] {
				--amp-shell-light-background-color: #fcfbf6;
				--amp-shell-dark-background-color: #090d12;
				--amp-surface-light-background-color: #fcfbf6;
				--amp-surface-dark-background-color: #0f161e;
			}

			html[data-amp-theme='theme-5'] {
				--amp-shell-light-background-color: #f8fafc;
				--amp-shell-dark-background-color: #09121c;
				--amp-surface-light-background-color: #f7f9fc;
				--amp-surface-dark-background-color: #0e1a28;
			}

			html[data-amp-theme='theme-6'] {
				--amp-shell-light-background-color: #ffffff;
				--amp-shell-dark-background-color: #000000;
				--amp-surface-light-background-color: #ffffff;
				--amp-surface-dark-background-color: #000000;
			}

			html,
			body {
				background-color: var(--amp-shell-light-background-color);
			}

			body:not([data-amp-app-mounted]) .app-shell [data-slot='sidebar-trigger'],
			.app-shell[data-app-mount-preview-loading] [data-slot='sidebar-trigger'] {
				position: relative;
				pointer-events: none;
			}

			/*
			 * Subject selectors here must be a class, not a type or `:not()` selector. Blink builds
			 * style invalidation sets from the subject's positive features; a subject with none
			 * (`:not(.sr-only)`) or a broad tag (`svg`, ~950 on a large thread) makes the
			 * `data-amp-app-mounted` flip recalculate style for most of the document (~650ms on a
			 * 12k-element thread) instead of the trigger's two children (~1ms). WebKit is
			 * unaffected either way.
			 */
			.app-shell [data-slot='sidebar-trigger'] > .app-mount-reveal {
				transform: scale(1);
				transform-origin: center;
				opacity: 1;
				transition:
					transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
					opacity 120ms ease-out;
			}

			body:not([data-amp-app-mounted])
				.app-shell
				[data-slot='sidebar-trigger']
				> .app-mount-reveal,
			.app-shell[data-app-mount-preview-loading]
				[data-slot='sidebar-trigger']
				> .app-mount-reveal {
				transform: scale(0.4);
				opacity: 0;
			}

			.app-shell [data-slot='sidebar-trigger']::after {
				content: '';
				position: absolute;
				top: 50%;
				left: 50%;
				/* 62.5% of the trigger's 0.875rem icon box; matches Loader's .loader-dot scale. */
				width: 0.546875rem;
				height: 0.546875rem;
				margin-top: -0.2734375rem;
				margin-left: -0.2734375rem;
				background: currentColor;
				border-radius: 9999px;
				transform: scale(0);
				opacity: 0;
				transition:
					transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1),
					opacity 120ms ease-out;
			}

			body:not([data-amp-app-mounted]) .app-shell [data-slot='sidebar-trigger']::after,
			.app-shell[data-app-mount-preview-loading] [data-slot='sidebar-trigger']::after {
				transform: scale(1);
				opacity: 0.65;
				animation: amp-app-mounting-sidebar-trigger-breathe 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
			}

			@keyframes amp-app-mounting-sidebar-trigger-breathe {
				0%,
				100% {
					opacity: 0.4;
				}

				50% {
					opacity: 0.8;
				}
			}

			@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
				.app-shell [data-slot='sidebar-trigger'] > .app-mount-reveal,
				.app-shell [data-slot='sidebar-trigger']::after {
					transition: none;
				}

				body:not([data-amp-app-mounted]) .app-shell [data-slot='sidebar-trigger']::after,
				.app-shell[data-app-mount-preview-loading] [data-slot='sidebar-trigger']::after {
					animation: none;
				}
			}

			html[data-amp-color-scheme='dark'],
			html[data-amp-color-scheme='dark'] body {
				background-color: var(--amp-shell-dark-background-color);
			}

			@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
				html[data-amp-color-scheme='system'],
				html[data-amp-color-scheme='system'] body {
					background-color: var(--amp-shell-dark-background-color);
				}
			}

			/* macOS auxiliary windows (thread-in-own-window) paint the app surface color
			   before hydration so the new window doesn't flash the shell background
			   (white-ish in dark mode). The native shell sets the marker at
			   document-start; see native-shell.ts getMacOSAuxiliaryWindow. */
			html[data-amp-auxiliary-window],
			html[data-amp-auxiliary-window] body {
				background-color: var(--amp-surface-light-background-color);
			}

			/* Thread windows start with the sidebar collapsed, but the server renders the
			   user's saved (usually expanded) sidebar state. Hide it until the client applies
			   the per-window collapsed state so it never flashes open and closed. */
			html[data-amp-auxiliary-window='thread']
				body:not([data-amp-app-mounted])
				[data-slot='sidebar'] {
				display: none;
			}

			html[data-amp-color-scheme='dark'][data-amp-auxiliary-window],
			html[data-amp-color-scheme='dark'][data-amp-auxiliary-window] body {
				background-color: var(--amp-surface-dark-background-color);
			}

			@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
				html[data-amp-color-scheme='system'][data-amp-auxiliary-window],
				html[data-amp-color-scheme='system'][data-amp-auxiliary-window] body {
					background-color: var(--amp-surface-dark-background-color);
				}
			}
		</style>
		<link rel="manifest" href="/site.webmanifest" crossorigin="use-credentials" />
		<!-- Keep the ?v= icon version in sync with appIconVersion in routes/site.webmanifest/+server.ts -->
		<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/app-icon.png?v=4" />
		<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Amp" />
		<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
		<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
		<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent" />
		<!-- Captures `beforeinstallprompt` before hydration so the PWA install flow
		     (lib/standalone/pwa-install-helper.svelte) can trigger it later. Inline with the
		     per-request CSP nonce, which SvelteKit only substitutes in this template, to avoid
		     a render-blocking external script request.
		     Cancelling the event only matters on Android, where it suppresses Chrome's automatic
		     install badge in favor of our install ribbon. Desktop Chrome shows its address-bar
		     install icon regardless, and cancelling there only logs "Banner not shown:
		     beforeinstallpromptevent.preventDefault() called" to the console. -->
		<script nonce="a3SnF1nfFD9YiEQXlb9Gwg==">
			globalThis.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (event) => {
				if (/android/i.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
					event.preventDefault()
				}
				globalThis.installPromptEvent = event
			})
		</script>
		<!-- Reports the browser's time zone on every page load, signed in or not, so the server
		     renders dates in it (VIEWER_TIME_ZONE_COOKIE in lib/viewer-time-zone.svelte.ts). -->
		<script nonce="a3SnF1nfFD9YiEQXlb9Gwg==">
			try {
				document.cookie = `amp-time-zone=${encodeURIComponent(
					Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone,
				)};path=/;max-age=31536000;samesite=lax`
			} catch {
				// Without the cookie the server renders dates in UTC.
			}
		</script>
		<link
			rel="icon"
			type="image/svg+xml"
			sizes="any"
			href="/app-icon.svg?v=4"
			data-amp-favicon
		/>
		<link
			rel="icon"
			type="image/png"
			sizes="192x192"
			href="/app-icon-192.png?v=4"
		/>
